name: on-the-fly-cost-calculation
title: Cálculo de costo de producción on-the-fly
description: Calcular dinámicamente el costo de producir un producto según su receta (insumos + cantidades) y el costo de mano de obra (salario de trabajadores / 160h × tiempo estimado de preparación). El cálculo se hace on-the-fly, no se persiste.
acceptance: Nueva migración V30: columna estimated_prep_minutes en products (nullable)
Campo estimatedPrepMinutes en Product domain, ProductEntity, ProductResponse, ProductRequest, mappers
Nuevo domain record ProductCost con totalCost, materialCost, laborCost, breakdown
Nuevo CalculateProductCostUseCase port + service que calcula materialCost = Σ(quantity × unitCost) y laborCost = (estimatedPrepMinutes/60) × avgHourlyRate
Nuevo método findActiveByAreaId en UserRepositoryPort + JpaUserRepository
Nuevo endpoint GET /api/v1/products/{id}/cost que retorna ProductCost
CalculateProductCostUseCase bean registrado en ProductConfigBeans
Tests unitarios cubriendo: costo solo materiales, costo con mano de obra, producto sin recipe, workers sin salario
./harness/harness.sh exit 0

tasks.description: V30 migration + Product domain change + JPA entity + DTOs + mappers
Create ProductCost domain record + CalculateProductCostUseCase port + findActiveByAreaId in UserRepositoryPort
Implement findActiveByAreaId in JPA repo + adapter, CalculateProductCostService, GET /products/{id}/cost endpoint, bean config

name: fix-v29-fk-before-drop-column
title: Fix V29 migration: drop FK before dropping column
description: V29 fails at runtime because it tries to DROP COLUMN selection_group_id while a foreign key constraint (fk_ppo_group) still references it. MySQL 8 refuses this. Fix: drop the FK constraint before dropping the column.
acceptance: V29 migration drops fk_ppo_group foreign key before attempting ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
./harness/harness.sh exit 0
App boots successfully with `task run` after the fix

tasks.description: Fix V29 SQL: add DROP FOREIGN KEY fk_ppo_group before DROP COLUMN
Verify harness green and app boots
